mentions.name: CouponVault
mentions.description: CouponVault is a mobile app for storing and managing gift cards and coupons. It offers access to coupons across all devices, automatic cloud backup, phone/tablet syncing, sharing of specific coupons and family sharing lists, expiration dates with reminders, marking coupons as used or archived, and instant filter/search/sort by category, store, or expiration date. It is offline-first, so users can keep all data on-device with sharing disabled.
mentions.problem: The author receives many gift cards for birthdays and holidays and many of them got lost, with no good existing place to store them.
mentions.audience: People who accumulate gift cards and coupons and need a place to keep track of them
mentions.source_excerpt:
